provenance.attribution: Workflow adapted by Mnemora for knowledge-note authoring: the upstream text is written for software delivery (pytest / git commit / worktrees). Mnemora keeps the upstream structure and decision rules, and rewrites the domain vocabulary for note planning, sectioned drafting, and source verification. Original work by Jesse Vincent (obra/superpowers), MIT.
provenance.adaptationNotes: Rewrites software-delivery terminology for note planning, section drafting, and source verification while preserving the upstream workflow structure and decision rules.
